page: Microsoft Azure NV12ads_A10_v5 is an x86_64 virtual machine instance within the NVADSA10v5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an AMD processor with 12 dedicated vCPUs and 110.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 9.17 GB of RAM per core.

This instance includes a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU configuration, representing 0.3333 of a physical GPU, which provides 7 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 369 GB SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The fractional GPU allocation offers a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand a full physical GPU, optimizing resource density. However, users must plan for the fractional GPU limits and the lack of complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This configuration is designed for workloads such as entry-level graphics rendering, remote visualization, machine learning inference, and database management requiring moderate GPU acceleration and high memory-to-vCPU ratios.

The instance is Premium Storage capable but does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The high memory-to-core ratio of 9.17 GB per vCPU supports data-heavy operations alongside graphical tasks, making it suited for remote visualization and light machine learning inference.
